| `eis-app-form-row` (`--2`), `eis-app-form-text`, `eis-app-inline` | Settings forms in `eis-panel__body`: fields side by side, as many as fit, as a row of fields (see "Rows of fields" below; `--2` exactly two equal columns for long fields such as textareas, one column at ≤760px), a short explanation in muted ink, a field (input or textarea) with its buttons on one line; the buttons keep their natural height, centred on an input and at the top of a textarea |
| `eis-app-message__head` title edited in place | Put the inline field (`<form class="eis-field">` with an `eis-app-inline` inside) in the `eis-panel__title`, after the number: the title grows and the field takes its room on the same line |
| `eis-app-items` (`__text`) | A list of saved entries: each row has its text in mono and small buttons |

For a row of metric cells, use the shared `eis-metrics` (elements.md, "Metrics").

Panel parts: `eis-app-agenda`, `eis-app-cells`, `eis-app-legend`, `eis-app-bar`, `eis-app-topics`, `eis-app-people`, `eis-app-done` and `eis-app-add-bar` have their own padding. Put them directly in an `eis-panel`, after its head, in place of an `eis-panel__body` (elements.md, "Panel structure"). Every other app component goes in a body. `scripts/check-css.py` keeps the same list in `PANEL_CONTENT`: change both together.

###### Rows of fields

`eis-app-add-bar`, `eis-app-form-row` and `eis-app-filters__fields` lay out their `eis-field`s the same way:

- Each field starts at a base width and never gets narrower than it. The base is the field's width helper (`eis-width-100` … `eis-width-500`), else the row's default: `--app-size-form-field` (256px), or in a filter bar `--app-size-filter-field` (192px) and `--app-size-filter-search` (224px). `eis-width-fit`: the field keeps the content's width. It does not grow, so the other fields take the free room.
- The fields share the free room of the row and grow with it. They do not keep a fixed width.
- A field grows up to `--width-400` (360px). A field with a wider base (`eis-width-500`) grows up to its base. So one field never stretches across the whole row.
- `eis-grow` marks the main field of the row (the text of a new task). It grows three times as fast as the other fields and has no `--width-400` limit. Use it on one field per row, or on none.
- A field goes to the next line only when it no longer fits. A field on a new line starts at the left.
- Write no width and no `flex` for this in page CSS. To make a field shorter or longer, change its width helper.

```html
<form class="eis-app-add-bar">
  <div class="eis-field eis-grow"><label for="t">Task</label><input class="eis-input" id="t"></div>
  <div class="eis-field eis-width-200"><label for="g">Group</label><select class="eis-select" id="g">…</select></div>
  <div class="eis-field eis-width-fit"><label for="d">Due date</label><input class="eis-input" id="d" type="date"></div>
  <p class="eis-app-inline"><button class="eis-button eis-button--ghost" type="button">Cancel</button><button class="eis-button eis-button--primary" type="submit">Save</button></p>
</form>
```

###### Sidebar collapse

The sidebar can collapse to a narrow strip (`--app-size-sidebar-collapsed`). Collapsed, it shows only the toggle. The toggle does not move. Only its arrow turns.

1. Give the sidebar an `id`.
2. Put the toggle last in the sidebar footer. Put links such as Settings in the main nav. The footer takes only links to other apps, in one `eis-app-nav__section` before the toggle:
   ```html
   <footer class="eis-app-sidebar__foot">
     <section class="eis-app-nav__section" aria-labelledby="nav-apps">
       <h2 class="eis-label" id="nav-apps">Apps</h2>
       <ul><li><a href="…">All apps</a></li><li><a href="…">Other app</a></li></ul>
     </section>
     <button class="eis-app-sidebar__toggle" type="button" aria-controls="sidebar"
             aria-expanded="true" aria-label="Sidebar" data-eis-app-sidebar-toggle></button>
   </footer>
   ```
3. Load `app/js/sidebar.js` at the end of `<body>`, after the icon scripts (elements.md, "Icons").

The script sets `aria-expanded`. The CSS reads it. The script keeps the choice in `localStorage` (key `eis-app-sidebar`, change it with `data-key`). The main content then fills the free space, up to `--app-size-main` (1200px). Below 1024px the sidebar is a drawer, the toggle is hidden and the collapse has no effect.

###### Mobile drawer

Below 1024px the sidebar leaves the page. A top bar takes its place, fixed at the top. Its menu button opens the sidebar as a drawer: it slides in from the left, over the content, and the page behind it is dimmed. Above 1024px the top bar is hidden.

1. Give the sidebar an `id`.
2. Put the top bar first in `<body>`, before the sidebar. The button is on the left, the page name on the right:
   ```html
   <header class="eis-app-topbar">
     <button class="eis-button eis-button--ghost eis-button--icon" type="button" aria-controls="sidebar"
             aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Menu" title="Menu" data-eis-app-drawer-toggle>
       <i data-lucide="menu" class="eis-icon"></i></button>
     <p class="eis-app-topbar__title">Page name</p>
   </header>
   ```
3. Load `app/js/sidebar.js` at the end of `<body>`, after the icon scripts.

The script sets `aria-expanded` on the button. The CSS reads it. When the drawer opens, the focus goes into it, and Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside it. These close the drawer:

- Esc, or a click outside it. The focus goes back to the menu button.
- A click on a nav item: a link, or a button that is not a sub-list toggle.
- A window that grows above 1024px.

The drawer shows the whole sidebar: section labels, nav, and the footer. A footer that holds only the collapse toggle (and `hidden` parts) is hidden. Without the top bar, a page has no navigation below 1024px.

###### Nav sub-list

An item of the nav can hold a list of sub-items. The arrow of the toggle points right when the list is closed, down when it is open. The CSS draws it (`--icon-chevron-left` from `shared/css/icons.css`): write no icon.

**The item is a page too** (a workspace with its teams): the item is a link, and an arrow-only toggle comes right after it. A click on the name opens the page. A click on the arrow, at the right of the count, opens or closes the list. Give the toggle an `aria-label` and a `title` that name the list.

```html
<li>
  <a href="#workspace/acme">Acme <span class="eis-app-nav__count">40</span></a>
  <button class="eis-app-nav__toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="nav-acme"
          aria-label="Acme teams" title="Acme teams" data-eis-app-nav-toggle></button>
  <ul class="eis-app-nav__sub" id="nav-acme">
    <li><a href="#team/growth" aria-current="page">Growth <span class="eis-app-nav__count">12</span></a></li>
  </ul>
</li>
```

**The item only groups the list** (one page per team under "Topics"): the item is a button with the item's text, not a link. A click anywhere on it opens or closes the list.

```html
<li>
  <button class="eis-app-nav__toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="nav-teams"
          data-eis-app-nav-toggle>Topics <span class="eis-app-nav__count">12</span></button>
  <ul class="eis-app-nav__sub" id="nav-teams">
    <li><a href="#team/growth" aria-current="page">Growth</a></li>
  </ul>
</li>
```

`app/js/sidebar.js` sets `aria-expanded` on both forms and keeps each list open or closed for the next visit (`localStorage`, key `eis-app-nav:` + the list id). The CSS reads `aria-expanded`. Sub-items are links, styled like the other items. In the mobile drawer a toggle opens and closes its list and the drawer stays open; a link closes the drawer.

###### Page head

Every app page starts with `eis-app-page-head`. It sets one standard top for all pages:

```html
<header class="eis-app-page-head">
  <p class="eis-app-page-head__meta">
    <time class="eis-label" datetime="2026-10-26">Monday, 26 October 2026</time>
    <span class="eis-mono">daily/2026-10/2026-10-26.md</span>
  </p>
  <h1>Daily</h1>
  <form class="eis-app-toolbar">…</form>
</header>
```

- `__meta` is optional. It is a full-width row above the title: the first child sits on the left (the page context, e.g. today's date), the last child on the right (a detail, e.g. the source file or the last update). One child only: it stays on the left.
- The `<h1>` is required. The toolbar is optional and sits on the right of the title.
- The main action of the page (New task, New topic) is `eis-button--accent`, with its Lucide icon. It is the accent of the page: use no other accent button on it. Main actions inside panels (each Save) stay `eis-button--primary`.
- Don't put a breadcrumb and a meta row in the same head. Don't build a page head with helper classes or page CSS: use this component.

###### Add a scope

1. Create `src/<scope>/tokens/<scope>.tokens.json`. Put every token under the group `<scope>`. Reference shared tokens where a value already exists.
2. Create `src/<scope>/tokens/<scope>.resolver.json`. Copy `src/web/tokens/web.resolver.json` and change the names.
3. Run `python3 scripts/build-tokens.py`. It finds the new scope and writes `src/<scope>/css/tokens.css`.
4. Create `src/<scope>/css/components.css`. Every selector starts with `.eis-<scope>-`. Then create the entry `src/<scope>/<scope>.css`: copy `src/web/web.css` and change the names.
5. Run `python3 scripts/check-css.py`. Then run `python3 scripts/build-css.py`. It finds the new scope and writes `dist/eis-<scope>.min.css`.
6. Add the scope to the table at the top of this section, to `README.md` and to `AGENTS.md`. Add its tokens to `tokens-usage.md` §7.
7. Add an example in `site/examples/<kind>/` and a card on `examples.html`.

---

### Checklist

Source: https://diegoeis.github.io/eis-ds/docs/manual/checklist.md

#### Checklist

Run this before calling a piece, element or token done. Every box must be true.

##### Files and CSS

- [ ] Links one scope entry (`web/web.css` or `app/app.css`, or `dist/eis-web.min.css` or `dist/eis-app.min.css`), then only its own layout CSS. No separate font link.
- [ ] Uses only shared classes and the classes of its own scope.
- [ ] Scope CSS or a page in `site/` changed? `python3 scripts/check-css.py` passes.
- [ ] No raw colours, font sizes, spacing or radii (only the exceptions in `tokens-usage.md` §8).
- [ ] Backgrounds, text, lines and accent use roles (`--surface-*`, `--ink*`, `--line`, `--accent*`), not primitives.
- [ ] Does not restyle any element from `elements.css`.
- [ ] Every class of the system starts with `eis-`. Every `eis-*` class on the page exists in eis-ds. Classes of your own page CSS use your own prefix (`doc-` on the pages of this repository).
- [ ] Variants change colour only.
- [ ] No shadows (except the built-in button hover glow), no gradients, no glow, no background grid.

##### HTML

- [ ] Semantic regions: `aside` for the sidebar, `main`, `header`, `nav`, `section`, `footer`.
- [ ] One `h1`. Headings in order.
- [ ] Tabular data in `<table>` with `thead`, `tbody`, `th scope`, `caption`.
- [ ] Controls are native: `button`, `a`, `input` (checkbox / radio / switch), `select`, `textarea`, `details`, `form`, `fieldset` + `legend`. No `div`/`span` pretending.
- [ ] Every control has a label. Invalid fields have `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby`.
- [ ] Visual-only elements are `aria-hidden`. Charts have `role="img"` + a data `aria-label`.
- [ ] Icons are Lucide: `<i data-lucide="name" class="eis-icon"></i>` in content, no typed character as an icon. Write no icon for a disclosure, a task group, notes, a done list or the sidebar toggle: the CSS draws it.
- [ ] Dates and times in `<time datetime>`.
- [ ] Each panel holds only its parts: head first, body, optional footer last, or a full-width part (table, list, disclosure, metrics, a scope panel part). No wrapper between the panel and its parts. No `eis-panel__body` inside another one. The Save of a settings panel is in its footer.
- [ ] A panel body that a script fills has the `id` itself (`<div class="eis-panel__body" id="…">`). No empty `<div id>` around or inside it.
- [ ] A panel body with two or more titled parts puts each part in an `eis-panel__section`. A body with one part has no section.
- [ ] Interface text is in English. Example data is fictional.

##### Visual rules

- [ ] Accent used once per piece, ≤ 5% of the area (or one declared accent block). Small state marks (a count badge, an overdue dot) do not count.
- [ ] Statuses are chips. Actions are buttons. The main action is `eis-button--primary` (one per view, or one per panel that saves on its own). In an app page head it is `eis-button--accent`, the page's one accent. Remove/delete is `eis-button--danger`.
- [ ] Every border and divider is `--line`, 1px.
- [ ] Numbers are mono and tabular. Labels use the label style. Running text is in sentence case.
- [ ] Two surface levels only: canvas and panel. No panel inside a panel.

##### Contrast

- [ ] You measured every text/background pair that is not in the pairing table (`tokens-usage.md` §1): ≥ 4.5:1 text, ≥ 3:1 large text and UI graphics.
- [ ] No white or `--ink-inverse` on `--accent`. No `--accent` as text.

##### Responsive

- [ ] Rendered and looked at in **375px, 768px and 1440px**.
- [ ] You dragged the window between them. `scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth` at every width from ~280px up.
- [ ] Auto grids use `minmax(min(<px>, 100%), 1fr)`.
- [ ] Nothing is clipped or overlaps. Tables reflow or scroll inside a wrapper.

##### Keyboard

- [ ] Every interactive element reachable with Tab, in a sensible order.
- [ ] Focus visible on all of them.

##### When adding to the system

- [ ] New token: in `src/shared/tokens/` (shared) or `src/<scope>/tokens/` (one scope), `python3 scripts/build-tokens.py` passes, shown on `foundations.html`, usage added to `tokens-usage.md`.
- [ ] New or changed element: in `src/shared/css/elements.css`, shown on `elements.html`, documented in `elements.md`.
- [ ] New or changed scope component: in `src/<scope>/css/components.css`, listed in `layout.md` §7, `check-css.py` passes.
- [ ] New scope: steps in `layout.md` §7, "Add a scope".
- [ ] New page in this repository: Google Tag Manager snippet first in `<head>` and first in `<body>` (copy from `index.html`).
- [ ] New example: in `site/examples/<kind>/`, card on `examples.html` with a 1440×900 PNG screenshot (`<name>.png`) and a descriptive `alt`. No live iframe.
- [ ] Manual or `llms.txt` changed: `python3 scripts/build-llms.py` passes. Commit `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` with the change.
- [ ] Decision recorded in `docs/visual-guidance/visual-guidance.md` §7.
